answer: Score each identity on cost of replication, being compute spent, distinct peers attested and hours up. Unlock balance only after 720 continuous uptime hours. A fake identity needs 720 hours of hosting at about three dollars a month plus attestations from twelve distinct peers, so a thousand fakes cost roughly three thousand dollars and twelve thousand peer interactions before the first token moves. That is eight times a full epoch reward. Onyx does not soften, every ripple is one more attestation, and timber gets spent either way.
